entry_sequence.transcript_quote: when the stock actually breaks above the v-wop after being below it at the opening bell i'm looking to buy on those pull backs
entry_sequence.action: Wait for a stock that opened below VWAP at the open to break back above VWAP.
entry_sequence.rationale: The reclaim of VWAP after opening weak is the milestone trigger for the setup.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: breaks above it with some volume coming in that's my favorite area to dip buy into
entry_sequence.action: Require volume to come in on the move above VWAP before considering the trade.
entry_sequence.rationale: Volume confirms the reclaim is meaningful in these momentum penny stocks.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: i'm buying on the pullbacks to test as a support area
entry_sequence.action: Enter long on the pullback/retest after the VWAP break, using VWAP as support.
entry_sequence.rationale: The trade is not the initial breakout; it is the dip buy on the support test.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: we bought into the pullback and we rode the bounce up
entry_sequence.action: Buy the bounce from the pullback once price respects VWAP and starts moving back up.
entry_sequence.rationale: The entry thesis is that VWAP holds and price bounces higher from it.

stop.rationale: The transcript teaches VWAP must hold as support but does not give a precise initial stop placement.

confluences.transcript_quote: i'm only attacking stocks that have an average volume over the last 20 minutes of over 200 000 shares traded per minute
confluences.name: minimum_liquidity_filter
confluences.description: Only trade stocks with average volume over the last 20 minutes above 200,000 shares per minute.

confluences.transcript_quote: i need this volume to be there if i'm going to take this trade if it's not i move on
confluences.name: volume_required
confluences.description: Volume must be present or the trade is skipped.

confluences.transcript_quote: i need the float to be under 50 million
confluences.name: low_float_filter
confluences.description: The stock needs a float under 50 million shares.

confluences.transcript_quote: especially under 10 million then it's gonna work a larger percentage of the time
confluences.name: prefer_very_low_float
confluences.description: Floats under 10 million are preferred for stronger momentum.

confluences.transcript_quote: opens weak on the day and actually drops at the opening bell below the v-wop
confluences.name: weak_open_below_vwap
confluences.description: The preferred setup starts with a weak open below VWAP.

confluences.transcript_quote: breaks above that v-wop area actually holding it as support and bouncing off of it
confluences.name: vwap_reclaim_and_hold
confluences.description: Price must break above VWAP, hold it as support, and bounce from it.

confluences.name: volume_on_reclaim
confluences.description: The move back above VWAP should happen with volume coming in.

confluences.transcript_quote: we had a ton of green candles in a row which obviously shows a lot of strength
confluences.name: obvious_bullish_momentum
confluences.description: The setup should show obvious strength with many green candles in a row.

confluences.transcript_quote: waiting for pullbacks after big runs like that especially to the v-wop or a whole dollar level like three dollars here
confluences.name: pullback_to_support_level
confluences.description: The pullback should return to VWAP or another nearby key support such as a whole-dollar level.

confluences.transcript_quote: i never buy these stocks if the v is above me
confluences.name: no_long_if_vwap_overhead
confluences.description: Do not take the long if VWAP is still above price acting as resistance.
